_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Electrical Power Capacity Report
summary: Documents the capability of the electrical power system to produce and distribute power required by utilization equipment, providing Standard Electric Load Analysis charts per MIL-E-7016 to verify interoperability of power sources and equipment.
use_relationship:
The Electrical Power Capacity Report documents the capability of the electrical power system to produce and distribute the power required by the utilization equipment.

Standard Electric Load Analysis charts are provided in accordance with MIL-E-7016 for maintaining electrical load configuration for existing, modified, and new electrical power systems. The data will be used to verify the interoperability of electrical power sources and utilization equipment.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the Electrical Power Capacity Report resulting from the work task described by the contract statement of work.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions shall be as specified in the solicitation or contract.

(Copies of the Military Specification, MIL-E-7016, Analysis of Aircraft Electric Load and Power Source Capacity are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil/)

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following information:

children.title: Electric loads and power source analysis charts
children.content: for each power source utilized by the system equipment prepared in accordance with MIL-E-7016, with the additional information:

children.title: Connected loads chart
The connected loads chart (Section 3.5.4.1) shall include
children.content: The connected loads chart (Section 3.5.4.1) shall include columns for the Load Type (e.g. Linear, Motor, Constant Power) and the Identifier for the connector or harness that supplies power to the utilization equipment.

children.title: Any symbol may be used in column D
children.content: Any symbol may be used in column D (Section 3.5.4.1.4.1) to denote leading power factor, as long as the symbol is clearly identifiable. The analysis shall document the meaning of the selected symbol and consistently use the same symbol to denote leading power factor across the entire analysis.

children.title: Loads that operate for longer than the
children.content: Loads that operate for longer than the time interval being analyzed and listed in column F (Section 3.5.4.1.6) shall be considered continuous. The analysis shall document the duration of continuous loads as the duration of that time interval.

children.title: The loads analysis chart shall include
Power utilization information for all equipment
children.content: Power utilization information for all equipment drawing power from system power buses

children.title: Operating conditions of the system, including
children.content: Operating conditions of the system, including each of the system States and Modes as well as power source failure conditions

children.title: Connected load charts, including equipment duty
children.content: Connected load charts, including equipment duty cycle for each load in each state

children.title: Transient load profiles associated with distinct
children.content: Transient load profiles associated with distinct operating conditions for each item listed as multiple entries for each item

children.title: Discharge profiles of bus hold up
children.content: Discharge profiles of bus hold up batteries within the system, including the time to reach the minimum operating voltage for the connected loads in each operating condition

children.title: A generation capacity analysis for system generated power during operating conditions, including source ratings for
Steady state conditions
Normal transient conditions
Overload conditions
Fault conditions
A distribution system analysis, including the capacity and power losses of the distribution system during the following conditions
Nominal loads included in the electric loads analysis
Overloads
Fault Conditions
